question: Who among the following won the bronze medal at the World Under-20 Wrestling Championship 2022, which was held in Sofia, Bulgaria?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Dahiya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **bronze medal **at the World **Under-20 Wrestling Championship 2022**, held at Sofia, Bulgaria, was won by **Rohit Dahiya.**
 
• Rohit Dahiya is a young Indian wrestler who has been making a name for himself in the sport.
 
• He has won **several medals** at the national and international levels.
 
• The World **Under-20 Wrestling Championship** is an annual event organized by the United World Wrestling (UWW) for wrestlers under the age of **20.**
 
 
• It is one of the most prestigious events in the sport of wrestling.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian freestyle wrestler **Bajrang Punia** competes in the **65-kg **weight class. 
 
• Punia defeated **Daulet Niyazbekov** of Kazakhstan 8–0 to win a **bronze medal** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics.**
 
• The only wrestler from India to win **four medals** at the World Wrestling Championships is Punia.
